name: week_plan
description: Private weekly allocation and change note for one Parle learner

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the owning learner

plan_key.description: Stable owner-scoped idempotency key for this week

week_start_local.description: Learner-local Monday date in YYYY-MM-DD form

week_start_utc.description: UTC ISO timestamp anchoring the local week

time_zone.description: Learner IANA time zone for display

allocation_json.description: JSON object with deterministic skill shares and allocated minutes

total_minutes.description: Total minutes in the scheduled tasks saved for this week

what_changed_note.description: One-line explanation of how this weekly plan was built

week_number.description: Week sequence used by first-week checks

premium_features_enabled.description: False for the current demo; gates premium planning triggers

status.description: Whether the weekly plan is the active version
